'''Ledis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|woman]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Ledis was a friend of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Lora Nadad]]. Following the end if the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the surviving [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] went into hiding and Nadad hid out in [[Jax Warehouse]] on Cularin. Ledis stayed there with her, along with [[Noelle]] and [[Klide]], some of Nadad's other friends. When the [[heroes of Cularin]] traveled to the warehouse, Ledis tried to give Nadad her her lightsaber, but the Jedi refused to take it. Ledis then held Nadad's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and threatened to impale herself if the heroes came any closer to her and Nadad.
